zh: 令原本純圖片的 PDF 分析書新增真正可檢索的原生 PDF 文字層：英文欄名、年份、金額、利率及現金流數字可直接搜尋／提取；完整圖表、中文內容、原有 8／13 頁分頁與 PDF 分享方式保持不變。文字層不會改變視覺、收益計算或收費模型。
新增「大字文字版」可捲動、選取的原生閱讀模式，跟隨 Android／瀏覽器的字體放大設定；同時新增「複製完整分析文字」功能，包括簡繁中文、逐年或逐月記錄、對比曲線對應數據、輸入假設及風險提示，可貼到微信／備忘錄；無須連接雲端。
PDF 為節省 App 體積，暫不嵌入多 MB 的中文字型；中文仍是清晰可見的圖像，不能宣稱整份 PDF 的中文字也能被搜尋。另提供完整中文可複製文字，避免讓長者誤以為已完整轉成可選文字 PDF。
加入完整中文文字、長者小屏大字剪貼簿流程、原生 PDF 真實文字提取、教育／退休關鍵數值及現有畫面一致性回歸。所有現金流公式、海報、分享圖片仍沿用原有模型。
en: Added an actual, invisible PDF text layer indexing English labels and financial numbers in previously image-only analysis PDFs. Years, amounts, rates and cash-flow values are searchable/extractable while chart layouts and existing calculations remain unchanged.

Added a native, selectable large-text report preview that follows device text scaling, alongside a complete Unicode copy action for Chinese/English headings, financial rows, comparison points, assumptions and risk warnings. Users can paste it into chat or Notes; no upload or account is needed.

Chinese characters in PDF remain image-backed and cannot yet be searched inside the PDF itself. This deliberate limitation avoids shipping large CJK font assets and growing the Android installer; full Chinese text is available separately through Copy.
Added native PDF extraction QA, mobile senior-font clipboard interaction tests, and real 8-/13-page report rendering checks. Financial formulas, poster design and share semantics remain intact.
